title: Add Android screen profiles and video controls
changes: Add persistent Raw, Unlit, Frontlit, Backlit and Classic screen profiles using the desktop color model and sRGB output, with automatic or manual darkening for reflective profiles.
Add an optional emulated-frame and OpenGL draw callback counter and adjustable pause-menu background transparency.
validation: Android ARM64 Docker build and 25 Kotlin tests passed in android-video-menu-apk-resume-agi0r44k.

Serial Android host Rust tests: 30 passed, 2 ignored; Mesa GLES world and panel color samples matched desktop lookup tables for four profiles and three darkening settings, with raw brightness samples checked.
limitations: No physical Android device test; OpenGL callback counts do not measure display refresh. Temporal response, grid, scaling and other desktop menu features remain unported.
